data.name: Mansurah
data.gender_notes: Mansurah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mansurah is an Arabic name that signifies victory and triumph, often bestowed upon girls born into families of high social status. The name Mansurah carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mansurah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mansurah is associated with the concept of Nasr, or divine support, as mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Mansurah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mansurah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: منصوره
in_arabic.meaning: المنصوره، أسماء بنت إسماعيل بن إبراهيم، وسميت كذلك لأنها منصوره من عارضاتها
in_arabic.long_meaning: المنصوره، أسماء بنت إسماعيل بن إبراهيم، وسميت كذلك لأنها منصوره من عارضاتها، وأصل الاسم من الصفة المنصوره، التي تشير إلى الشخص الذي ينجح في مكافحة العدو أو من ينجح في مهمة محنته، وفي الإسلام، يعتبر اسم منصوره من أسماء الرجال والنساء، ويحيط بالشخص الذي يحمل هذا الاسم صفات قوية، مثل الصبر والثبات، ويتميز بالفكر العميق والتصميم، وفي بعض البلدان، يعتبر المنصوره أسماءً للنساء، ويحمل معنى قويًا من النجاح والفوز، ويتميز بالروح المتفوقة والقدرة على النجاح في مهام الصعب

data.cultural_impact: Mansurah holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world, as it is associated with strength, resilience, and achievement. It has been traditionally given to newborn girls as a symbol of the triumphs and victories they are expected to experience throughout their lives, especially if they come from a family of influential stature. The name is believed to become a source of inspiration and motivation, inspiring the girl to overcome any obstacles that may come her way and to achieve great things. Mansurah also reminds people of the important role of women in Islamic history, who have contributed significantly to society and have conquered various challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Mansurah represents the idea of conquering one's inner struggles, fears, and weaknesses. It encourages the woman to seek victory over her own ego, negative emotions, and lower tendencies, thereby developing a strong and stable character. The name also symbolizes the struggle for spiritual enlightenment and growth, as every person goes through various life experiences that test their faith and belief in Allah. Ultimately, Mansurah is a reminder of the importance of holding steadfast in one's convictions and trusting in Allah's guidance and wisdom to achieve victory in all aspects of life.
